description: One call, 8 chains: native balance, USDC/USDT balances (main contracts per chain, addresses returned), nonce (txs sent), and account type (EOA, EIP-7702-delegated EOA with its delegate, or contract) on base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, gnosis and celo, plus USDC/USDT totals and the chains where the address is active. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: GET /api/wallet-snapshot.
name: wallet_snapshot
title: Wallet snapshot across 8 EVM chains
